meta.title: CoBuilt Solutions — Ready Mix Concrete, Addis Ababa
meta.description: CoBuilt Solutions supplies high-quality ready-mix concrete (C05 to C70) from a fully automated XCMG two batching plants in Goro/Balo, Addis Ababa, with GPS-tracked mixer trucks and concrete pumps.

hero.text: Concrete built to last. High-quality ready-mix from our fully automated two batching plants in Goro/Balo, Addis Ababa, for Ethiopia's growing infrastructure and building needs.

items.name: Addis Ababa City Construction Works Bureau

services.title: We are
services.text: From the mix design to the last truck on site, one team handles your concrete end to end.

items.title: Ready-mix concrete
items.text: Customizable mix designs from C05 to C70 and beyond, batched to your project specification.

items.title: Mixers & pumps
items.text: Supplied via modern transit mixers and concrete pumps for high-rise and hard-to-reach pours.

items.title: Delivery logistics
items.text: GPS-tracked fleet and planned dispatch so trucks arrive when your crew is ready.

items.title: Technical consultation
items.text: Mix design recommendations and construction support from our engineers and lab team.

plant.title: Fully automated
plant.text: We partner with global industry leader XCMG Schwing to run a state-of-the-art plant. Accurate mixing and consistent quality let us serve large-scale projects with speed and reliability.

lab.title: Every input
lab.text: Our in-house lab runs granulometric analysis of aggregates, slump and flow tests, compression testing and custom mix design optimization for each project.

materials.name: Admixtures
materials.note: For workability, setting and strength gain

materials.name: Clean water
materials.note: Meets standards for mixing and curing

grades.title: C05 to
grades.text: Mixes designed to ES EN 206-1 / ASTM C94, using ES-marked Lemi OPC. Prices per m³, excluding pumping.
testedBy: AAU College of Technology & Built Environment

fleet.title: GPS-tracked.
fleet.text: Modern drum systems keep concrete fresh during delivery, and our tracked fleet ensures timely dispatch across the city.

testimonials.title: What our
testimonials.text: From a 32-floor tower in Kazanchis to a wastewater treatment plant at Koye Feche.

items.quote: Their team consistently demonstrated excellent coordination, high-quality standards, and a strong commitment to timely delivery.

items.text: Our engineers confirm the mix and book your delivery slot.

items.title: Batch & deliver
items.text: Batched in our automated plant, dispatched by GPS-tracked trucks.

contact.text: Send your grade, volume and date. We reply quickly with a price, a mix design recommendation and available delivery slots.
